finalText:
All 12 files check out clean.

Migrated the last 12 files still on `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the style already used elsewhere. All pass `node --check`.

One holdout remains: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`, which still calls `db.query` twice. It's a vendored file marked "do not edit, replaced wholesale on every upgrade," so I left it alone. Worth deciding separately, maybe wrapping it or patching upstream, since `db.query` is slated for removal.
